stage: preregistration: smoke tests only have been run; values seen are disclosed per hypothesis

hypotheses.anchor: family 003, QuasiRiemannHypothesis.lean (Lean statement faithful; source scan clean; NOT compiled here)
hypotheses.statement: If zeta(s) != 0 for Re s > 7/8, then psi(x) = x + O(x^(7/8) log^2 x) and M(x) = O_eps(x^(7/8+eps)).
hypotheses.novelty: classical implication (von Koch/Ingham for psi; Littlewood for M); new only in that family 003 would make it unconditional
hypotheses.test: none numerical (cannot fail at computable x); deliverable is a Lean statement locked as a target

hypotheses.statement: For every fundamental D < -4: L(1, chi_D) * log log|D| >= c_train, c_train = min over 7 <= |D| <= 1e6.
hypotheses.test: h2_class_numbers.py: PARI class numbers for all fundamental D, |D| <= 1e7
hypotheses.decision: PASS if min over holdout 1e6 < |D| <= 1e7 is >= c_train; FAIL otherwise

controls.positive: 9 Heegner discriminants with h = 1 in |D| <= 1e6; h(-23)=3, h(-47)=5, h(-71)=7
controls.negative: min L(1,chi_D) over [1e6.5, 1e7] < min over [1e5, 1e5.5] (wrong-order statistic must drift)

hypotheses.known_weakness: c_train is likely set by small |D|, so the holdout test is weak; the dyadic-window minima are reported as the informative trend

hypotheses.statement: If every Dirichlet L-function is zero-free in Re s > 7/8, then psi(x; q, a) = x/phi(q) + O(x^(7/8) log^2 x) uniformly in q and (a, q) = 1 (non-trivial for q <= x^(1/8 - eps)).
hypotheses.novelty: classical implication of a uniform zero-free half-plane; unconditional only via family 003; compare Siegel-Walfisz (q <= (log x)^A)

hypotheses.anchor: family 143, QuinticLienard.lean (faithful; source scan clean; NOT compiled here)
hypotheses.statement: Classical Lienard systems of degree 6 have at most 4 limit cycles (the De Maesschalck-Dumortier lower bound is sharp).
hypotheses.novelty: unchecked: no upper bound for degree 6 was found in the 2026-10-07 search; sharpness not claimed in the sources read
hypotheses.decision: REFUTED if any confirmed count >= 5 at degree 6; a confirmed 3 at degree 5 contradicts upstream's formal theorem; otherwise 'not refuted (low power)'

controls.positive: van der Pol -> 1 cycle; averaging-built quintic -> 2 cycles

hypotheses.known_weakness: random search does not reach the canard regime where De Maesschalck-Dumortier's 4 cycles live; the instrument has not reproduced 4 at degree 6

hypotheses.anchor: 'An L3 bound for the dyadic triangular Hilbert form' (2026-10-05), Theorem 1.1, constant 40; NOT Lean-formalized (family 082's Lean covers only the continuous maximal estimate)
hypotheses.statement: The best constant C* in sum_k sum_{I in A_k} |L_I| <= C* prod ||F_v||_3 equals 2.
hypotheses.decision: REFUTED if any ratio > 2 + 1e-9 at any N; a ratio > 40 contradicts upstream's Theorem 1.1; supported (not proved) if every run stays <= 2 + 1e-9 and an exact rational witness attains 2

controls.positive: F = 1 gives ratio 1 exactly; vectorised L_I equals a direct loop at N = 2 (<1e-12)
controls.negative: Haar-free form at F = 1 gives N + 1 (grows with scales): 4 at N = 3, 7 at N = 6

hypotheses.outcome: REFUTED 2026-10-07 by the preregistered run: ratio 5/2 at N = 4 (exact rational witness, h5_exact.py verify)

hypotheses.amends: H5 (refuted); amendment written AFTER the H5 runs and the N=5 sign-flip exploration, BEFORE the confirmatory runs below
hypotheses.anchor: same as H5 (unformalized upstream Theorem 1.1, constant 40)
hypotheses.statement: The best constant C* in the dyadic triangular Hilbert estimate equals 5/2.

evidence_before_amendment.exact_witness: N=4 +-1 inputs, exact ratio 5/2 = 1 + 1/2 + 1/2 + 1/4 (scales -3..0) + 1/4 (top term): rigorous C* >= 5/2
evidence_before_amendment.sign_flip_search: N=5, 900 s: lifted witness stays 5/2; random start reaches 3041/2048

hypotheses.confirmatory_test: h5_dyadic.py at N = 7 (restarts 12, seed0 7000) and N = 6 (restarts 40, seed0 6000); seeds never used before
hypotheses.decision: REFUTED if any ratio > 5/2 + 1e-9; otherwise 'not refuted' (a numerical search cannot prove an upper bound)
